ending.caption.1: You bring the album and postcard to Grandma
ending.caption.2: Grandma looks at young Grandpa's photo
ending.caption.3: She tells a warm story about that day
ending.caption.4: You both laugh at Grandpa's old haircut
ending.caption.5: The album case ends — the Yesterday Library hook begins
ending.line.1.child: Grandma! I found it — and a weird postcard too!
ending.line.2.grandma: There he is… Grandpa when he was young
ending.line.3.grandma: He had just bought a new bicycle. I still remember the oil smell
ending.line.4.grandma: But that haircut… I told him not to!
ending.line.4.child: Haha he looks like a fluffy chick!
ending.line.5.child: Then next time we go there!
dialogue.albumPortrait.hint: You have Grandpa's photo and the postcard — show Grandma!
dialogue.grandmaShow.title: Show Grandma the postcard
dialogue.grandmaShow.text: There is Grandpa's photo — thank you. Sit with me; I will tell you a story
dialogue.grandmaNeedPoster: Did you find the album? If you found a postcard too, bring it to me first
toast.posterTaken: Postcard kept — show it to Grandma
toast.caseComplete: Event complete — home again. Tap an empty slot to place Grandpa's photo
egg.revealBody: A young-Grandpa sticker was stuck on the fan blade — Grandma hid it for sure
